home.heroTitle: Proactive Oral Health Awareness Powered by AI
home.heroSubtitle: Learn about dental diseases, evaluate oral symptoms through guided awareness assessments, and understand when to consult your dentist—in English, Hindi, and Marathi.
home.feature1Desc: Evidence-based answers backed by clinical dental literature with transparent source citations.
home.feature2Desc: Interactive 5-step risk assessment flagging warning signs and empowering your next dental visit.
home.feature3Desc: Full voice input, Text-to-Speech, and native translations in English, हिंदी, and मराठी.
home.feature4Desc: Prescription blockers, red-flag emergency triage, and strict distinction between education and medical advice.
